method: For each marked Q1920, compute Aut(Q), enumerate the exact pointwise-A centralizer in Hol(Q)=Q semidirect Aut(Q), and evaluate the collision involution relations by exact affine-pair multiplication.
collision_relations: t c s c t^-1 c s t c=1
scope: This excludes completions contained in the natural holomorph of either marked Q1920. It is not a universal-colimit collapse theorem; a completion may act outside Hol(Q) and need not normalize Q.
